name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A library of 'best practice' instruction packs that teach AI coding agents to follow a professional software team's actual workflow — planning, building, testing, and reviewing — instead of just guessing.
buyer: An engineering manager who has adopted AI coding agents across the team but is seeing inconsistent quality, and wants every agent to follow the same senior-engineer-approved process.
business_use_cases: An engineering org standardizes every developer's AI agent on this workflow to reduce review churn and bugs.
A consultancy sells a 'professionalize your team's AI coding workflow' engagement built around installing and tailoring it.
A solo developer selling SaaS products adopts it to keep their AI-assisted codebase maintainable as it grows.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid workshops teaching engineering teams how to adopt structured agent-skill workflows like this one.
Build a companion dashboard that tracks whether a team's agents are actually following the DEFINE-PLAN-BUILD-VERIFY-REVIEW-SHIP steps, sold as a subscription.

steal_this: Run a half-day workshop this weekend teaching a small dev team to adopt this skill set, record it, and sell the recording as an on-demand course.
